gui.distantstock.manual.p1: First place and enable an unlocked Stock Link on the warehouse server. Distant Stock publishes it to every connected server. Players can open an untuned requester anywhere and select an open network without visiting the warehouse. Use a joined requester on a telegraph to copy it there.
gui.distantstock.manual.p2: The warehouse uses a Create packager. Face the dock cabin toward the operator and leave the sides free for a belt or hopper. An import dock matches address only (blank = *). Unpack with a packager if needed. A parcel in the bay means the slots are occupied.
gui.distantstock.manual.p3: Players never type an IP. OP runs /distantstock, or sneak-clicks a monitor. Pick Host (warehouse) or Client (outer), fill self id, listen, peer, password. Save writes this server's config/distantstock-common.toml and restarts the listener. Same password on every side.
gui.distantstock.manual.p4: One warehouse, many survival servers. Orders carry from=self.id. After packing, the warehouse POSTs the package only to that origin. Outer servers pull /stock from the host only. Outer servers do not act as warehouses for each other.
gui.distantstock.manual.p5: Goggles show live data only: dock mode, short freq or address, UP/DOWN, slots or backlog. Desk: freq, address, catalog size. Monitor: TPS and queue. The tutorial lives in this book. Set giveManual=false to stop handing one out on first join.
item.distantstock.requester.desc: Open it to join a distant network published by the connected servers.
item.distantstock.manual.desc: Field book for networks, docks, belts, and server setup. Hold W to ponder.
block.distantstock.dock.desc: Full-block casing with side logistics access. Hatch parcel = loaded; aether markings = link.
block.distantstock.gauge.desc: Floor stock desk. Use a joined requester to write its network.
block.distantstock.monitor.desc: Wall dashboard: local/peer TPS and link pressure. OP sneak-click opens link setup.
distantstock.ponder.distant_export.text_: The warehouse still packs with a Create packager. Distant Dock does not pack.
Feed sealed packages from the side or back. A hopper, funnel or belt can sit against any face.
The cabin faces the operator. Leave the neighbouring faces free for logistics.
A parcel in the bay means the dock has something queued to send. It is not a shared stock network.
distantstock.ponder.distant_import.text_: On the other server, sneak-click the dock with a requester to set receive mode and an address.
Pull sealed packages out with a hopper or funnel. Unpack them with a Create packager if you need the items.
This is another JVM. The two stock networks stay separate; only the sealed parcel hops.
distantstock.ponder.distant_tune.text_1: Open the portable requester and join an unlocked warehouse Stock Link. No IP is typed in the block.
distantstock.ponder.distant_tune.text_2: Right-click a dock with the tuned requester to set export. Sneak-click sets receive.
distantstock.ponder.distant_tune.text_3: The request desk copies the same network and address. It sits beside the line, not on the parcel path.
distantstock.ponder.distant_status.text_: Aether rails stay dull when the link is down. Online only brightens the glass, not the whole machine.
The wall monitor shows local and peer load. Sending a request is not the same as a parcel arriving.
If the bay is full, the peer retries. Keep the dock chunk loaded and the address matched.
